game.name: Dadish
game.rules:
**General Rules:**

* Video proof is mandatory.
* Sound is not required, but encouraged.
* IGT is mandatory for Individual Levels
* Only one person can run the game per run.
* It is allowed to quit into the Menu to skip a world transition cutscene but not between Levels

**Timing methods:**

* Individual Levels use the in game timer.
* Multi-Level Runs Time starts on the when Dadish leaves the ground in the first level. Time ends on the last level when the controls disappear or the First frame of the 180° spin after touching the child.

categories.name: Segmented
categories.rules: The total time for the full game based on the best timings for each IL. (total time shown on level select screens)

categories.name: Boss Rush
categories.rules:
Beat all boss levels.

Menu time counts.

Collecting the key after the boss is when the boss is considered complete. Except for the last boss where you must talk to the radish.

Timing starts when you leave the ground and ends when you reach the last kid Do not submit for 100%.

categories.name: All Worlds
categories.rules:
**Levels : **

* Complete levels 1 to 40 in one continuous run.
* The levels need to be played in order.
* You can leave the level and go to menu to skip dialogues/cutscene (only on Mobile)
*Also read the Main Rules for more detailed Version
